Subject: Re: Pilot packaging thoughts and budget constraints

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Marcus and I reviewed the usage profile and cost estimate internally. We're excited by Redwood's latency and the quality on our sample prompts, but our procurement lead flagged the model-access line item as higher than expected for a 4-week evaluation.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you propose an option that keeps the pilot under a fixed spend (target: $12k) but gives us enough headroom for multi-region tests?
- If we convert to production within 30 days of the pilot, is there any credit or rebate you can apply to offset the pilot cost?

Attaching our short requirements doc (traffic profile + compliance notes). We'll need a 2-week extension if we can't get budget approved quickly — can you outline what that would look like (cost, deliverables)?

Cheers,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@finly.com>, Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@finly.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot packaging thoughts and budget constraints

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the requirements doc. We've sketched three pilot packaging paths that fit different procurement preferences; I attached a short proposal (RI-Proposal-Finly-20260812.pdf) with numbers. TL;DR options: 

1) Fixed-seat pilot (simple) — $11k
   - 3 named seats, 80k tokens/day cap, single-region (us-west).
   - No credits; counting metered overage at standard pilot rate.

2) Credit bucket (flex) — $12k
   - 120k token credits usable across regions, auto-topup disabled.
   - Better for bursty tests, slightly higher effective unit cost.

3) "Sprint Bundle" (hybrid) — $12k (recommended)
   - 2 reserved seats + 60k credits + 1-week free runway (effectively a 5-week pilot).
   - Includes a one-time voucher (3000 token units) for multi-region verification and a single canary in eu-west for compliance testing.

Conversion incentive: if Finly signs a Dedicated or Reserved commitment within 30 days of pilot close, we will apply a $3k credit toward the first invoice (applies to options 2 or 3).

Extension mechanics: we can extend the pilot by up to 2 weeks. For the Sprint Bundle, the 1-week free runway becomes 3 weeks free if you convert to a paid contract within 14 days of extension end (this is a one-time concession).

Ben is copied with a sizing note and Priyom will own the contracting flow. If you want, we can lock the Sprint Bundle price for 7 days while you confirm procurement.

Next step: confirm which option (seat | credit | sprint) you prefer and your procurement contact. If agreeable, I'll share an updated SOW and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI-Proposal-Finly-20260812.pdf

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. A few clarifying items from our side: 
- The multi-region voucher in the Sprint Bundle — is that limited to a single EU canary region or can we run parallel canaries in both eu-west and us-east? Our compliance team likes dual-region verification.
- For the $3k conversion credit, can that be applied to consumption for the first 60 days rather than an invoice-level credit? That helps us budget the initial ramp.
- Procurement contact is Jamie Liu (cc'd) — she'll own PO and legal redlines.

If possible, we'd like to hold the Sprint Bundle price while Jamie runs the PO. Also, Elena asked about a 2-week extension to the pilot if we need more time for compliance — would Redwood bill anything for that extension in the Sprint Bundle scenario?

—Marcus
CTO, Finly

Date: 2026-08-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot packaging thoughts and budget constraints (sizing + tech note)

Marcus / Team —

Quick technical note on sizing that affects packaging economics:
- The KV cache hits on your typical prompt mix are ~45% (per sample), which means effective tokens served will be ~30% lower once cache is primed.
- If you can standardize the prefix templates (we can help), you should see even better reductions.

Given that, the credit bucket option could comfortably fit into $10.5k of spend for the 6-week expanded run (credit burn smoothing). The Sprint Bundle still gives the best operational safety: reserved seats plus credits cover both steady-state and spikes without surprise overages.

Attached a quick sizing workbook and a worked example for sprint vs pure credits. Also — for the extension: we can do a 2-week extension in the Sprint Bundle at no extra charge if you commit to initiating procurement within 10 business days of the extension start. Otherwise extension billed at 50% of pilot daily rate.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the workbook.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sizing_estimate.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Finalized Sprint Bundle terms & next steps

Hi all —

Thanks for the fast turn. Summary and next steps below so procurement has everything in one place: 

What we agreed (Sprint Bundle, locked until EOD Aug 20):
- Price: $12,000 pilot package (Sprint Bundle).
- Contents: 2 reserved seats, 60k token credits, 1-week free runway (becomes 3 weeks free if conversion executed within 14 days after extension end).
- Multi-region voucher: Up to two canary runs (eu-west + us-east) included.
- Conversion credit: $3,000 applied as consumption credit across the first 60 days after go-live (not invoice-level; applied to token consumption billing).
- Extension: 2-week extension available at no charge provided procurement issues a PO or written intent within 10 business days of extension start. Otherwise extension billed at 50% pilot daily rate.

Docs I'm attaching: Finly-SOW-v2.pdf (SOW + acceptance criteria). I will send a DocuSign link once you confirm Jamie as procurement owner and the legal redline windows. HubSpot deal is updated here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/Finly/DL-2026-1147.

Please confirm by replying with either: 
1) "Confirm — Sprint Bundle" and Jamie's PO/email for sending the SOW, or
2) "Need changes" with the specific item(s) (we'll triage internally and respond within 48 hours).

If I don't hear back by EOD Aug 20 I'll provision the Sprint Bundle in a holding state (no charge) for 48 hours so you can complete procurement without service interruption.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Finly into a production-ready evaluation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Finly-SOW-v2.pdf
